scientific_integrity: The exact identity is proved algebraically; finite rational computations are corroboration, not the proof of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: All claims are for iid Bernoulli bits conditioned on one residue of the sum modulo three; no assertion of full association or negative dependence.
The arcsine empirical limit requires an irrational angular frequency; other biases have periodic phase sequences.
Independent mathematical auditing and exhaustive historical priority verification have not been performed.
title: Oscillatory pair dependence under modulo-three Bernoulli conditioning
